desc: Ideate on the problem structure and complexity constraints.
Identify the FWHT approach as the optimal solution ($O(W \cdot 2^W)$).
Implement the FWHT function (both forward and inverse).
Parse the grid rows into integer masks and count the frequency of each unique row pattern into an array `cnt`.
Construct the kernel array `K` where `K[mask] = min(popcount(mask), W - popcount(mask))`.
Apply Inverse FWHT to the result.
Find the minimum value in the resulting array and print it.
Run the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., $H=1, W=1$) are handled correctly.
